searchText: EIP-8038 has a variable STORAGE_CLEAR_REFUND to refund gas for clearing a slot. Monad charges on gas limits, so operations that require consuming a large amount of the state gas and then revert them will be most severely affected. This does not happen on Ethereum.

excerpts.author: gaxanh
excerpts.content:
EIP-8038 has a variable STORAGE_CLEAR_REFUND to refund gas for clearing a slot. 

Monad charges on gas limits, so operations that require consuming a large amount of the state gas and then revert them will be most severely affected. This does not happen on Ethereum.
